newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland sells PLN 4 mln fixed bonds at 1 bln tender.
newsitem.headline: Poland sells PLN 4 mln fixed bonds at 1 bln tender.

text.p: The Polish finance ministry sold four million zlotys worth of its 15-percent two-year bonds and rejected all bids for the 12-percent five-year bonds at today's one billion zloty tender, the finance ministry said.
Bids for the shorter paper totalled 195.1 million zlotys and for the longer bonds 76 million zlotys.
The minimum price for the two year bonds was 89.47 against 89.69 at the last auction on June 3, the average price was 89.61 against 89.81 and the maximum price was 89.70.
